scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter @bobo/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && pnpm --filter @bobo/api exec wrangler deploy

DB.description: The app's D1 database. Migrations run on every deploy.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: The app's address, e.g. `https://bobo.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev` (the subdomain is under **Workers & Pages** in the dashboard), or your own domain. Sign-in only works from this address.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: 32+ random characters, e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Signs sessions; changing it signs everyone out.

ENCRYPTION_SECRET.description: 32+ random characters. Encrypts the AI keys people save for Siri voice logging.
